captions: 30 Dec 1864: the Cardiff Times and the Cardiff and Merthyr Guardian print the death of Amy, 'relict of the late Mr. John Williams, Great House farm' (CH-0015)
1866: the present St Dochdwy's Church is consecrated; its c.1820 predecessor is moved and rebuilt at Leckwith (CH-0016)
1 Jan 1872: glebe land in Llandough parish is conveyed as a school site (Glamorgan Archives P35CW/9) (CH-0017)
moment.basis: The 1872 rate book entry (reference pending) records John Williams rated for glebe land, owner Rev. H.H. Rickards (CH-0018, EV-0212). The vestry setting and the people present are inferred.

continuity: The rate book stays open on the vestry table as the clerk turns to the new poor rate: John Williams for a farm owned by Lord Bute, Lord Bute's woods in hand, and Daniel Thomas & Son's lime kiln and quarry.
